title: Accept a typed model ID for a cloud family in the CLI
text: The controller accepts a cloud model ID that its catalog does not list, the way the desktop's typed model does, and the client rejects a wrong one on the first turn. The CLI refuses such an ID in --model and in the saved selection of cli.json, so a person cannot reach a model the list has not caught up with. In chooseSelection in apps/cli/src/chat/scripting.ts, accept an unlisted model ID for the openai, anthropic and google families when it matches ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:[\]-]{0,199}$. The effort then defaults to default unless the flag names one. A listed model behaves as before. Local still needs a model its catalog lists on this computer, and an ID that does not match the pattern is still refused with the existing usage error.

verification.method: The checks ran in a clean export of the base commit with the hidden files from the solution commit in place, and had to fail. They then ran in a clean export of the solution commit, and had to pass. Installed dependencies were linked from the checkout, and the checks ran with a minimal environment and a temporary home.
